WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.385373 41.311256)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 340 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.385373, 41.311256), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_subset AS (
  SELECT
    rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      ST_Envelope(ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 3857))
    )
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Reclass(
      ST_Clip(
        dem_subset.rast,
        ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 3857), 10000, 'quad_segs=8'), -- buffer to ensure coverage
        1
      ),
      1,
      '0-340:0,340-9999:1',
      '8BUI'
    ))).val AS elevation_below_340,
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Reclass(
      ST_Clip(
        dem_subset.rast,
        ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(poi_geom.geom, 3857), 10000, 'quad_segs=8'),
        1
      ),
      1,
      '0-340:0,340-9999:1',
      '8BUI'
    ))).geom AS geom
  FROM
    dem_subset,
    poi_geom
),
nearest_distance AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Distance(poi_geom.geom, ST_Transform(elevation_analysis.geom, 4326))) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    elevation_analysis,
    poi_geom
  WHERE
    elevation_analysis.elevation_below_340 = 0
)
SELECT
  ROUND(distance_meters::numeric, 2) AS distance_to_elevation_below_340_meters
FROM
  nearest_distance;
